{{Quote|Tibanna's very important to our war effort. It's used in blaster weapons and lasers &mdash; and it's much more efficient than Barigen or Thelton.|Captain Eedan|<ref name="Wind Raiders of Taloraan">{{JournalCite|5|Wind Raiders of Taloraan}}</ref>}}
'''Eedan''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Procurement and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] division of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[occupation of Bespin]], he was charged with finding a new source of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]].
